surfaces.part: sign head, white oval lid that overhangs the board
green board with the white text 약국 (front face)

answer.evidence: The width profile at rows 0-8 is 8,12,16,16,16,16,16,14,8, so it widens and then narrows again, which makes an ellipse. It is a pale oval lid from row 0 to row 7. Its front rim is the greenish row 7, and the dark row 8 under it acts as eave shadow. The head is wider (16) than the board below it (14), so it overhangs. Below it, rows 9-31 are a tall dark-green front panel 23 rows high with white lettering, and that is the clear south face. The head is the only horizontal surface and it is drawn as an ellipse, not a flat strip, so the sign reads as three-quarter view. The board has no side face drawn.

styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate is a vertical sign with a white shaded cap and a dark green body with a lighter inner border and light-green Korean lettering. It has 8 visible tones per tile, above bus-shelter-a (6) and below kiosk-a (12) and vending-a (20). Near-flat coverage is 0%, against 9% for bus-shelter-a, so no large flat fills. Dark edge pixels are 0% neutral, so the outline is a tinted dark green rather than a black sticker line, and the green body is separated from the white cap by value. The body ramp is about 3-4 steps plus the lettering and the cap highlight, a little shallower than the vending machine but equal to or better than the accepted bus shelter. The sign is a thin, simple object, and it would not look noticeably thinner or flatter beside these references, so I pass it despite the slightly lower richness than the vending machine.

surfaces.part: sign board front face with the vertical text '약국'

answer.evidence: The width profile runs 8, 12, 16 (rows 2-6), 14, 8 over rows 0-8, so the silhouette widens and then narrows again. That is an ellipse-like top plate drawn as a light, near-white surface. Its lower edge is a green front-edge line at row 7, followed by a dark outline and shadow at row 8. Below it, rows 9-31 form a 14-wide dark green front face carrying the white Korean text, with a dark band at rows 9-10. That is about 23 rows of vertical south face, with no receding side face. The plate is a thin top, but it reads as a horizontal surface above a front face.

styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate is a narrow vertical sign in dark green with a white cap and Korean lettering. It shows 8 visible tones per 16x16 tile, which is above bus-shelter-a (6) and below kiosk-a (12) and vending-a (20). Near-flat coverage is 0%, so there are no large flat fills. Dark edge pixels are 0% neutral, so the outline leans green and reads as a dark material tone rather than a black sticker line. The green body has about 3-4 steps (highlight edge, mid, dark, deep) and the white cap about 2-3. The lettering adds some variation but the sign face is simple, with no grain or speckle. Shading is shallower than the kiosk and vending references, and the piece is slimmer and plainer than both. It is acceptable next to bus-shelter-a but not as rich as the other two, so I rate density slightly lower. When in doubt, fail.
